title: Filter Library Profile overrides by designation
summary: Filter Movie-only and TV-only Library Profile override controls by profile designation while preserving inherited direct-copy defaults as displayed non-overrides.
reason: TV Library Profiles showed Movie target/fallback controls, and inherited direct-copy bucket controls could appear blank when the active config omitted keys that have backend defaults.
behavior_before: Library Profiles rendered Movie and TV route-size/fallback controls together regardless of designation. Missing global direct-copy keys could leave inherited Library Profile controls blank even though backend metadata had defaults.
behavior_after: Backend field metadata marks Movie-only and TV-only controls with additive library_profile_designations metadata. The WebView hides and omits inapplicable controls for Movie/TV profiles, keeps both for Auto profiles, warns when designation-specific overrides are pruned from a staged LibraryProfiles patch, and inherited direct-copy controls display effective backend defaults without becoming overrides.
tests_added: Backend metadata tests assert Movie-only/TV-only library_profile_designations and direct-copy bucket fields remain all-designation.
Library profile tests assert missing global direct-copy/route-size keys inherit backend metadata defaults.
WebView static tests assert designation filtering, warning, pruning, and re-render wiring.
Browser settings/launch smoke asserts actual Library Profile DOM filtering, inherited direct-copy display, Auto designation visibility, and TV patch pruning.
